# Sport Core Pilates

> Performance-focused Pilates for active adults and athletes in Mumbai. Train stronger, move better, stay injury-resilient. Built on the philosophy of Pilates First. Performance Driven.

Sport Core Pilates is a premium athletic Pilates studio based in Bandra West, Mumbai. The brand delivers performance-driven Pilates training through a proprietary class structure — SCP Foundation, SCP Control, SCP Performance, and SCP Reform — designed for progressive strength, control, and movement quality. The studio also offers private training and operates an education platform called Future of Movement.

## Classes

- [/scp-foundation](/scp-foundation): Beginner-friendly Pilates programme for those new to the practice.
- [/scp-control](/scp-control): Intermediate class focused on control, precision, and core stability.
- [/scp-performance](/scp-performance): Advanced performance-driven Pilates for athletes and active adults.
- [/scp-reform](/scp-reform): Reformer-based Pilates training for strength and conditioning.
- [/scp-ante-natal](/scp-ante-natal): Personalised equipment-based Pilates designed to support strength, movement, and confidence throughout pregnancy.
- [/scp-post-natal](/scp-post-natal): Structured post natal Pilates program to help mothers rebuild strength, restore movement, and return to activity with confidence.
- [/private-training](/private-training): One-on-one and small-group private Pilates sessions.
